integrity: The all-rank proof is algebraic; finite enumeration is reproducibility support, not an infinite theorem certificate. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the binary extended Hamming family, optimized over permutations; no claim about decoding, uniqueness of all extremizers, all linear codes, or beyond the proved span. Historical near-terrace formulations remain a disclosed residual risk.
title: Optimal two-window coverage and three-window burst covering for binary extended Hamming codes
